parts.text: I keep the shared picture of the airspace by working on the network of flight corridors between sites, the zones grouping them, and closures announced by the authorities. When a closure is entered, I want to know how much disruption it caused across customers. What worries me is that closures can come into force while drones of several companies are already in the air, and they are often amended during the day, such as when an area is widened or an end time moves.
